offers_products.reason: Asset-manager model: managed REITs and funds own the properties; RMR sells management services, not goods.

offers_services.reason: Provides property management, asset management and advisory services to managed REITs, funds and joint venture partners.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Clients are the managed REITs and institutional investors in funds, separate accounts and joint ventures.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Management contracts with REITs and institutional investors via separate accounts, joint ventures and funds.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing management fees from long-term contracts with managed REITs and private capital vehicles.

cyclical_demand.reason: Base management fees from REIT contracts continue through downturns and aren't easily cut.

big_ticket.reason: Revenue is steady periodic management fees, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for staff expertise in property management, leasing, engineering and investment management.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are public REITs and institutional investors, not households or small businesses.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light manager; the managed REITs and funds own the real estate.
